title: Pesarattu
description: Andhra green moong dosa made from a ground whole-moong batter with ginger and green chilli, crisp at the edges and protein rich.
steps: Drain the soaked moong and rice and grind with the ginger, green chilli, cumin seeds and salt, adding about 150 ml of water, to a smooth pourable batter.
The batter should be thinner than idli batter but thicker than neer dosa batter, so adjust with a splash of water if needed.
Heat a non-stick tawa and sprinkle a few drops of water; it should sizzle and evaporate quickly.
Pour a ladle of batter in the centre and spread outwards in a circular motion to a thin round.
Scatter a spoonful of chopped onion over the top, drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook for 2 minutes until crisp.
Fold and serve hot with coconut chutney or ginger chutney.
